biotools.summary: The InChI Open Education Resource (OER) provides resources, training materials, and information related to the IUPAC International Chemical Identifier (InChI). It aggregates over 100 resources and offers search and filtering functionalities, aiming to support chemical educators and promote understanding of InChI's role in science.
